Console sweep on /login, /dashboard, /chat, /changelog, /for-teams, /wlad-control-x7k9q2: only ignorable noise (401 on /api/auth/refresh, posthog/analytics 401 — per instructions). action_items: None — everything the Iter-135 audit spec asked for passes. Optional (deferred, not blockers): (1) /payment-success as UNAUTHENTICATED user currently redirects to /login rather than showing the error card + retry-btn (still graceful, no white screen). Consider allowing the error card to render without auth so operator-shared links stay actionable. (2) Onboarding Step 3 (Position/Unternehmen/Branche) requires filling three text fields before 'Weiter' activates — this is correct product behaviour but Playwright scripts need to fill those to progress. Neither is an audit-blocking issue.
critical_code_review_comments: OpsHandoverPanel.js: default-open section 'ai-wrong' means a naive automated click on ops-section-ai-wrong toggles it CLOSED and steps disappear. Consider tracking 'open' set instead of single string, or add data-open=true attribute so tests can distinguish 'already-open' from 'closed'.

PaymentSuccessPage.js: works fine for authed users (retry-btn shows in ~3s on bogus session). For unauthenticated /payment-success?session_id=... the router redirects to /login before the error card can render — consider making /payment-success public so returning Stripe redirects always land on a usable page even if the auth cookie has expired mid-checkout.

OnboardingPage step 3 (role) doesn't expose data-testid on the position/company/industry inputs — the story-mentioned role-<id> testids only surface after these text fields are filled. Add data-testid=onboarding-position-input etc. so operators/regression tests can drive the full 9-step flow deterministically.
